content: Building on the public preview introduced in July 2026, this release enables customers and partners to use symmetric encryption capabilities with the oct-HSM key type and the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm directly within Azure Key Vault Premium for production workloads. Customers can use AES algorithms to encrypt, decrypt, wrap, and unwrap data while continuing to benefit from Azure-managed security, compliance, and operational controls. AES algorithms with 256-bit keys are aligned with CNSA 2.0 requirements and can help organizations prepare for post-quantum cryptography readiness scenarios. Key benefits include: Centralized key management: Securely manage symmetric keys through Azure Key Vault Premium. Hardware-backed key protection: Support for oct-HSM symmetric keys. AES cryptographic operations: Support for encryption, decryption, key wrapping, and unwrapping. Production readiness: Ready with the performance, scalability, and reliability required for production workloads. Simplified integration: Integrate symmetric key management with existing Azure security workflows. Consistent security controls: Benefit from Azure-managed security, compliance, and operational capabilities. Learn more: Learn about keys Read the documentation
